text: @nicearrack/dsh-translator 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的划词翻译插件。它在选中文本旁显示浮动按钮，并通过翻译卡片呈现译文；用户可拖动、固定卡片并复制译文。插件提供免费公共翻译接口和 harness 大模型两种引擎，支持自动回退服务、设置目标语言、超时与模型参数，并对重复请求使用缓存。它适合在阅读网页消息、侧栏或输入内容时快速理解片段。使用免费接口时，选中文本会发送给翻译服务；选择模型引擎则调用已配置的 harness LLM。

@nicearrack/dsh-translator adds selected-text translation to DSH Web. A floating button opens a card with copyable results. Choose public services or the harness LLM and set a target language. Answers can be cached. The free API sends text to its provider; the model engine uses the configured LLM.
我想在 DSH 网页里选中一句话就看到翻译。
有没有能把侧栏里的外文快速译成中文的功能？
让 DSH 支持划词后弹出翻译按钮。
想把选中的内容交给当前配置的大模型翻译。
我需要不用填写 API Key 的文本翻译方式。
能不能把翻译卡片固定住，方便继续查看？
I want a quick translation popover when I select text in DSH.
Can DSH translate snippets using the model I already configured?
I need a no-key translation option for text in the web interface.
Let me pin a translation result while I keep reading.
划词后，DSH 网页会在选区附近显示翻译按钮；点击后打开结果卡片，支持网页中的消息、侧栏和输入文本。
可在插件设置中选择免费公共接口或 harness 模型引擎。免费接口可自动尝试多个服务；模型引擎使用当前会话的模型配置。
插件根据选中文本与主语言判断目标方向：主语言文字译为英语，其它文字译为所选主语言，支持简体中文、繁体中文、日语、韩语和俄语。
翻译卡片可拖动、固定或关闭，也能复制原文或译文；重复文本可复用缓存，并可通过重试重新请求。
插件配置页可设置翻译服务、目标语言、超时，以及模型、推理等级、最大输出 token 和温度；配置改变用于后续翻译。
免费 API 翻译会将选中文本发送到腾讯、Bing、火山或 MyMemory 中实际响应的服务；可切换到 harness 模型引擎。

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · dsh-translator：- **Free API** (default) — public translation endpoints. No account, no key, nothing to configure.
- **Model** — the harness's own LLM. Your text stays inside the model pipeline you already configured.

|---|---|

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · Install：On the DSH **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin** and give either the npm package name or the GitHub address:

```
@nicearrack/dsh-translator
https://github.com/nicearrack/dsh-translator
```

To remove it later, uninstall it from that same page.

To update, uninstall it and add it again — the npm package name and the GitHub address both resolve to the latest release. The new version takes effect once DSH restarts.

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · Usage：Select text → click the floating **translate** button → the translation card appears. Drag the card by its header, or pin it so it can't be dismissed by accident. Click the translation (or the source text, or an error message) to copy it.

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · Features：- Select text anywhere; the button follows the selection and adapts to light/dark. A touch or pen selection raises it too, and a selection that wraps lines anchors the button at the point it ended rather than at the whole block
- Direction is automatic: text in your **primary language** becomes English, anything else becomes your primary language. Primary language: 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский
- Settings sit on the plugin's own page. Picking the **Free API** engine shows just the primary language, the service and the timeout; picking **Model** swaps in the model controls. Changes apply to the next translation, with no restart
- The card's footer names what answered — the endpoint for Free API, the model for Model — and marks a reused answer
- Copy, drag and pin. One card at a time — but a card you pin stays where you put it, still finishing if it was mid-translation, while you translate something else
- Asking for the same passage again is answered from a short-lived cache, so it costs one request, not two. **Retry** deliberately ignores the cache and asks again
- A translation that came back unchanged is labelled as untranslated in

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · The free API engine：Public endpoints run by Tencent, Microsoft, Volcengine and MyMemory. None of them needs registration, an API key or a token. Requests go out from the DSH host process rather than the browser, so there is no CORS negotiation and no cookie is sent. Automatic mode walks the chain and benches a failing provider with a backoff that starts at 30 seconds and caps at five minutes; any one page may make 60 requests a minute, after which the card asks you to wait a moment.

Two things worth knowing:

@nicearrack/dsh-translator README · The free API engine：- These are **undocumented web endpoints, not official APIs**. They carry no SLA and can change without notice — which is why the chain exists. If every one of them is down, the card says so and points at the **Model** engine.
- **Your selected text leaves the machine** and goes to whichever provider answers. The first free-engine translation a browser performs says so in the card, once; after that it is not shown again. If that is not acceptable, use the **Model** engine.
